Hagenes Inc [name of lessee], of 35685 Vergie Hollow [street address], State of California, hereinafter referred to as "Lessee", collectively referred to herein as the "Parties", agree as follows:

### 1. DESCRIPTION OF LEASED PREMISES:

The Lessor agrees to lease to the Lessee the following described ___ square feet (SF) of ___ located at ___ [street address], State of California.

### 2. TERM OF LEASE:

The term of this Lease shall be for a period of 1 year(s) 0 month(s) commencing on the 1 day of June 2025, and expiring at Midnight on the 1 day of June 2026. ("Initial Term")

### 3. BASE RENT:

The net monthly payment shall be ___ dollars ($9993) per month. A security deposit of ___ dollars ($5324) is required. payable monthly with the first payment due upon the is required. payable monthly with the first payment due upon the commencement of the Lease and each monthly installment payable thereafter on the 1st day of each month

### 4. Options to Renew (Check one):

✓ Lessee may not renew the Lease.
